newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank sets 7-day repo at unchanged 5.05 pct.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank sets 7-day repo at unchanged 5.05 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, set on Tuesday a new seven-day reverse repurchase operation at an unchanged fixed rate of 5.05 percent.

The repo rate, which is the central rate of the Riksbank's three-tiered interest rate corridor, was cut to 5.05 percent from 5.15 percent on September 24 in the central bank's 20th pruning of its key rate this year.
The other two elements of the corridor, the deposit and lending rates, are currently set at 4.75 percent and 6.25 percent, respectively.
